name: atlas
description: A project-management team for client software projects: Atlas (PM and tracker), Alice (discovery), Stark (design), Jarvis (plan), Sentinel (test and release) and Spartan (gates).

interface.shortDescription: From client meeting to handover, tracked
interface.longDescription: Six agents that turn meeting transcripts into a PRD and proposal, design and plan the system, track the real build from git, run test and release gates, and produce client reports and a handover pack — with a tamper-evident project log.
